attempts.summary: Configured keepalived (VRRP) on node1 and node2, both OpenWrt hosts on the shared 10.100.40.0/24 private network, to jointly serve a shared virtual IP 10.100.40.200 (node1=MASTER priority 150, node2=BACKUP priority 100, same virtual_router_id 51, interface br-lan). Demonstrated automatic failover by capturing a healthy baseline, then stopping keepalived on node1 while node3 ran a continuous 0.3s-interval ping to the VIP: only 2 packets were lost during the ~1.4s transition before node2 took over the VIP and ping continuity resumed. Restarted node1 and confirmed it preempted the VIP back automatically. Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time native reboot on all three nodes (node1, node2, node3), verifying changed boot_id after each restart and confirming keepalived/VIP ownership and node3 reachability recovered fully after each restart, in cluster-safe order (failover pair fully healthy before touching node3).
